refnamediv.refpurpose: Parse an X509 certificate and return the information as an array

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
certificate
X509 certificate. See Key/Certificate parameters for a list of valid values.
short_names
short_names controls how the data is indexed in the array - if short_names is &true; (the default) then fields will be indexed with the short name form, otherwise, the long name form will be used - e.g.: CN is the shortname form of commonName.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns an &array; of certificate fields on success, or &false; on failure.
alias is present only when the certificate has an alias. Every other key listed below is always present.
Array returned by openssl_x509_parse
Key Type &Description;
name string
Subject distinguished name as a single string, with components separated by slashes. For example, /C=US/O=Example/CN=example.com.
subject array
Subject distinguished name. Keys are short names such as CN when short_names is &true;, and long names such as commonName otherwise. Each value is a UTF-8 &string;, or an &array; of UTF-8 &string;s when that component occurs more than once.
hash string
Lowercase hexadecimal hash of the subject name, as used to look up a certificate in an OpenSSL CA directory. This is an 8-digit value. It is not the certificate fingerprint; see openssl_x509_fingerprint.
issuer array
Issuer distinguished name, in the same form as subject.
version int
Raw version field stored in the certificate. This value is one less than the certificate version usually displayed: a version 1 certificate is 0, a version 2 certificate is 1, and a version 3 certificate is 2.
serialNumber string
Decimal representation of the serial number.
serialNumberHex string
Uppercase hexadecimal representation of the serial number.
validFrom string
Not-before time in ASN.1 form, either UTCTime (YYMMDDHHMMSSZ) or GeneralizedTime (YYYYMMDDHHMMSSZ).
validTo string
Not-after time, in the same form as validFrom.
validFrom_time_t int
Not-before time as a Unix timestamp, or -1 if the time could not be parsed.
validTo_time_t int
Not-after time as a Unix timestamp, or -1 if the time could not be parsed.
alias string
Certificate alias (friendly name). Only present when one is set.
signatureTypeSN string
Short name of the signature algorithm.
signatureTypeLN string
Long name of the signature algorithm.
signatureTypeNID int
Numeric signature-algorithm identifier (OpenSSL NID).
purposes array
Purpose checks, indexed by purpose id. The ids are the X509_PURPOSE_* constants. Each value is an &array; described below.
extensions array
Certificate extensions, indexed by short name (for example subjectAltName) or by OID when the extension has no short name. Each value is printable text describing that extension. Which keys are present depends on the certificate. This array does not follow short_names.
Each element of purposes has the following keys:
Purpose entry
Key Type &Description;
0 bool
&true; if the certificate can be used for this purpose as an end-entity certificate.
1 bool
&true; if the certificate can be used for this purpose as a CA certificate.
2 string
Purpose name. A short name such as sslclient when short_names is &true;, and a long name such as SSL client otherwise.
